answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 66 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in walnut, queued in inlet, and harbor publishes the wait time. A farm of 305 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3068 identities would post 4588 proofs and burn roughly 76 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
